name: Standard Sales Order Creation Flow
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order OrderTypeCode (e.g., 'YORB')
expected_outcome: Message routed via SalesOrder branch (SequenceFlow_82), Test_Mapping executed, custom header logging executed via Interface_Generic_Headers, terminates at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200 OK.
validates: CallActivity_4 (Property InputPayload and generic headers), ParallelGateway_74, ExclusiveGateway_80 (SequenceFlow_82), CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping), CallActivity_13 (Header logging), EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Processing Flow
trigger: Inbound SOAP message matching SO Return criteria (e.g., OrderTypeCode 'ZRET' or Return condition)
expected_outcome: Message routed via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71, generic headers logged, message terminates at EndEvent_9 without invoking Sales Order mapping.
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 routing logic for SO Return condition (SequenceFlow_113), CallActivity_71, EndEvent_9

name: Routing Condition Unmatched - Default Escalation
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unmatched OrderTypeCode (e.g., 'UNKNOWN')
expected_outcome: Message routes to default path SequenceFlow_110, triggering Escalation End Event EndEvent_11 with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'.
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path (SequenceFlow_110) and EscalationEndEvent EndEvent_11 error code handling

name: Transformation Failure Triggers Exception Subprocess
trigger: Inbound SOAP message matching Sales Order route but with corrupted body triggering MessageMapping exception
expected_outcome: Exception SubProcess_91 caught by StartEvent_92, CallActivity_97 enriches message body from property 'InputPayload', CallActivity_100 logs original payload, flow terminates at EndEvent_95 (EndErrorEvent).
validates: SubProcess_91, CallActivity_97 (enricher restoring body from ${property.InputPayload}), CallActivity_100 (Log_Payload), and EndEvent_95

name: Boundary Condition - Missing OrderTypeCode Node
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with empty or absent <ns2:giic_OrderTypeCode__c> element
expected_outcome: XPath router evaluates condition to false; routes safely to default Escalation branch without throwing uncaught null pointer exception.
validates: XPath resilience on ExclusiveGateway_80 and fallback to EndEvent_11

name: Security Authorization Rejection
trigger: Inbound SOAP call without required ESBMessaging.send user role or invalid client certificate
expected_outcome: SOAP sender adapter rejects the incoming request with HTTP 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden before reaching StartEvent_2.
validates: Inbound SOAP adapter endpoint security configuration (RoleBased / ESBMessaging.send)
